answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the terrace is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the pigment until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vault of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
